fato_historico: 2015: A building collapses in the Pakistani city of Lahore resulting in at least 45 deaths and at least 100 injuries.
energia_do_dia: The cosmos invites you to embrace deep renewal today. Just as a structure may rise or fall in the sands of time, your inner strength remains unshakable. Consider this a beautiful moment to rebuild your foundations with resilience and grace. You may find that letting go of the past brings newfound clarity to your hidden, powerful aspirations.
frase_do_dia: Strength is not just rising, but blooming beautifully from the shadows of experience.
significado_numero: Represents the structural integrity of your emotional landscape.
conselho: Focus on rebuilding what matters most with patience and gentle kindness today.
